purpose: Design of the /forge:start-design orchestrator skill that creates design documents from requirements, from upstream design through existing-pattern matching, detail design, consistency check and review.
summary: Overview: requirements-first design, then matching with existing implementations, then detail design
Flowchart from preparation through phases 1 to 6 to completion
Preparation steps: requirement identification, feature, output dir, differential check, completely-new check, mode, state table, norms
Phase 1 collects project rules via query-db-rules
Phase 2 upstream design from requirements only, with approvals and ID numbering
Phase 3 matching with existing implementations and design patterns, redesign loop, spec comparison and type determination
Phases 4 to 6 detail design, consistency traceability check, AI and user review
Handling of needs not in the requirements: stop, report, and record approval in an ADR
Completion steps and design principles: build from requirements, reuse existing, full coverage, What/How boundary
tasks: Judging differential development for design documents
Handling requirements gaps discovered during design
